notes.title: Demo Playtest Update 1.12
notes.notes:
[h3] Dear Exiles[/h3]

[h2] We're excited to announce that the latest version of Shelter of Exiles 1.12 is now available on the Demo public build. [/h2]

[h3]New content:[/h3]

[list]
[*] New resource: Treasures. 
[*] Earn it by completing Objectives and use it in Vendor to open treasures with rewards.
[*] Game Account Bonus - Activate a time-based bonus to play.
[*] YOU CAN HAVE A DOG NOW ːsteamhappyː
[*] During the game, you may come across a rare event of encountering a golden mushroom man or shadow collector who have valuable loot with them.
[*] Experimental offers in the vendor for premium currency.
[*] Players can access their ID in the game settings.
[/list]
[h3]
Balance changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Monster health scaling reduced by 2% per level.
[*] Monster damage scaling increased by 1% per level.
[*] Reduced the number of waves needed to win in most missions.
[*] Objectives on World Map resets every 4 hours instead of 24 hours now.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Destroying terrain objects correctly triggers their effect.
[*] A dryad should not give a reward when losing.
[*] Grindzone should not cause the game to crash.
[*] Objectives should not cause the game to crash.
[*] Boss powers should be called correctly.
[*] The game should not get stuck at the exit of the first mission.
[*] Item stats should compare correctly.
[*] Shade monsters should not lag the game.
[*] The hero should not attack bombs on his own.
[*] The Elusive should properly end at the end of the effect.
[*] The Health on Kill and Energy on Kill stats should correctly add hp/energy.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]

In no particular order:

[list]
[*] Statistics in the Inventory menu scrolls very slowly with the use of the mouse scroll
[/list][i](it is suggested to click left mouse button and drag the list for more comfortable use for now)[/i]
[list]
[*] Experience bar animation stopped to work for some reason
[*] The claim button in Questlog is visible before the Questlog animation ends.
[*] Skill tooltip shows raw formula description instead of calculated results
[*] If the player clicks quickly on the hero his animation resets and doesn't perform any attacks
[*] Frog status doesn't disappear while it should.
[*] Bow animation cancels if we use a spell
[*] Wrong place for the Player Character head on plane hierarchy.
[*] Weapon particles show in the wrong rotation
[*] After exiting the game with the use of Alt+F4 and coming back to play, player characters shows without equipment. It fixes once we enter inventory again.
[*] Negative cooldown on some uses of skill during the play
[*] A few typos in some spell descriptions
[*] Skull icon is stretched and cut in the Summary screen
[*] Beest enemy health bar is not appearing.
[*] Mysterious weapon in Vendor has an icon that doesn't fit other icons
[*] Hoovering on the tooltip in the moment of battle end causes it to freeze for scene change
[*] Sometimes levels are loading with the wrong background
[*] Damage prevention statuses don't protect from the poison
[*] After defeat in the Grindzone music on menu does not change
[*] Bushers randomly moonwalk sometimes
[*] World map pins changing their state after each victory
[*] There should be an overlay for monitors with a different ratio than 16:9
[*] Random entity position is not working as intended yet
[*] Sometimes players can't buy items in Vendor after quest completion while having enough gold
[*] Quick two tap of skill allows using skill twice before cooldown should allow it
[*] Vendor interface covers the information of possessed gold during the trade
[*] If the character moves during drain status damage dealing there is a bug with damage numbers animation
[/list]
[list]
[*] Sometimes loot icon shows outside the map
[*] some achievements may double
[*] Territorial doesn't work
[*] The player can attack an elusive target if one spawns near the Player Character
[*] Whirlwind particle animation sometimes connects to other targets causing visual bugs of skill reach
[*] Ally can sometimes attack the Player. Traitors!
[*] Quick use of push/pull can make ignore an entity having Fear status.
[*] In some cases, monster position changes at getting on get damage type
[*] There are some issues with Defence Stance behaviour at Player changing position 
[*] 
[/list]
Good Luck and Have Fun.

For our Discord community, there are several patch-related contests available on our Server:
[url=https://discord.gg/aEYryA8BK3]https://discord.gg/aEYryA8BK3[/url]

Fight for your place on the pre-season leaderboards of Shelter of Exiles and grab the rewards!

notes.title: Demo Playtest Update is now LIVE on beta branch
notes.notes:
[h3] Dear Exiles[/h3]

[h2] We're excited to announce that the latest version of Shelter of Exiles 1.11.1 is now available on the beta branch of our Demo. [/h2]

Instructions on how to join playtests can be found at the end of the text.

We would also grab a moment and appreciate the support we received from our community so far.

[h2] [b] You are making the Shelter of Exiles a better and better game! Thank you! [/b] [/h2]

[h3] List of changes and new features in public since Demo version 1.7.3[/h3]

[h3] Cloud save and player account[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a cloud connection that allows you to save and load player data from Unity Gaming Services.
[*] Added the ability to create a test account that stores player progress. 
[/list]
[b] IMPORTANT:[/b] During playtests, progress may be reset between versions. 
This is essential for the game's production process. Please understand :) 

[h3] Stats and effects:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A passive ability system has been added that allows various game mechanics to add automatic effects that trigger in the right situation.

[*] Legendary items have been added that grant the hero passive special abilities.
 
[*] Experimentally removed Main Stats and completely changed the stat assignment philosophy to items to make different weapon and armor types more distinctive.
[/list]
[h3] Task board[/h3]
[list]
[*] A system of quests has been added, which are carried out between games.

[*] Added procedural generation of daily quests.

[*] The level building system has been changed.
[/list]
[h3]Battlefield[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added bonus spawners that generate objects independently of the main spawner, e.g. power-ups.

[*] Dynamic scaling of the location level to the player's level has been added.
[/list]
[h3] Player character[/h3]
[list]
[*] New character animation system.

[*] A new hero skeleton.

[*] A new hero animator.

[*] New shell system - faster shells and movement paths.

[*] Added hero animation for victory and defeat.
[/list]
[h3] Resources[/h3]
[list]
[*] New resource - Wood (currently not applicable in the game).

[*] New resource - SOEX (currently not applicable in the game).
[/list]
[h2] Poziomy[/h2]

[h3] Mapa świata[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new map interface that replaces the previous level panel.

[*] Different types of pins for different types of activities on the map: Main Missions, Side Missions, Caves, Objectives, Grindzones.

[*] Ability to interact with levels from the World Map.

[*] Visibility of progress status on the map.

[*] Unlock more activities on the map.
[/list]
[h3] Battlefield modifiers. [/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional game modifiers that can add special mechanics to the level, additional sets of enemies and power-ups, and other special elements, expanding the base level.
[/list]
[h3] Generative Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Procedurally create levels from component elements.

[*] Ability to randomize initial board settings, enemy sets, loot, victory conditions, and game modifiers.

[*] Auras can now be generated as ground effects on terrain.
[/list]
[h3] Grindzone system[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new game mode in which we can play stages with increasingly difficult challenges, for more and more rewards.

[*] Reloading Grindzon Stages.

[*] Grindzon's difficulty increased with subsequent stages.

[*] Bonus rewards offered for the next stage of Grindzon.

[*] A stack system that causes you to accumulate items from the run and get them only when you leave Grindzon victorious, or lose them in defeat.

[*] Added the ability to use Flare to save items when defeated.
[/list]
[h3] Cyclical activities[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cyclically refreshed (Implicitly daily) generative levels that give us one chance to pass and that offer us a bonus reward for winning.
[/list]
[h3] New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] 60 new levels
[*] 6 new Caves with bosses
[*] 5 generative, cyclically refreshed missions
[*] Grindzone
[/list]
[h3] New opponents[/h3]

Steam Next Fest is here,  our demo just joined the celebrations and its ready to play!

You can find Download Demo button on our Steam page now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655600/Shelter_of_Exiles

[previewyoutube=RwQoBpmfUM0;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to take a moment to say Thank You! Fueled by feedback from our precious Playtest beta-testers, we have implemented numerous improvements to the game's UI, balance, and level progression since Playtests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/7d08ede00840d9125ab8ef763127c0a5f1460309.png[/img]

[b]Overall Shelter of Exiles Demo contains:[/b]

🔹Over 20 levels with varied game objectives and battlefield rules.

🔹A variety of skills and spells to discover and try out.

🔹Confrontation with several types of enemies, from Spider Healers to Mushfiend Entanglers and Poisonmist Frogs, 

🔹Many equipment pieces, sets, and other goodies to loot.

We feature a classless system of combat. Your equipment and spells shapes your build. Mix, max, and explore to find the playstyle that suits you best and change it anytime you feel like. It takes around 3-5 hours to beat the Demo and another 3-5 to explore it's full content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/6d1c7046cc56734148c48658c909fef170766932.jpg[/img]
[b]What comes after the demo release?[/b]

Few patches for demo, some additional content.
Then full sail ahead at the game release, which will include:

🔸Online and community features,

🔸Player-driven economy,

🔸Reforged animations, spell effects and music

🔸a map full of mysterious dungeons and ruins,

🔸more of everything.

and comes at the end of Q3.

There will be more beta-test rounds to try and test all this stuff earlier, somewhere in the middle of the road.

notes.title: Playtests are now LIVE
notes.notes:
[h3]Happy New Year, Exiles![/h3]

[b]We would like to express our gratitude for all the requests we have received so far and are excited to announce that you can now play Shelter of Exiles[/b] :)

The first wave of Playtest access has been granted. You should receive an email from Steam regarding Playtest participation and be able to find the "Shelter of Exiles Playtest" app in your Steam library.

We wholeheartedly appreciate your engagement and hope that the adventure with the game's demo version will be an unforgettable experience for you.

[h3][b]As these are playtests, we would like to draw your attention to a few important matters:[/b][/h3]
[list]

[*] The game is currently in a very early stage of development. During the playtests, we provide you with the core combat system and loot and inventory for testing. Additional functionalities will be added in the following months.

[*] We count on you not only to share your impressions with us during the playtests but also to help us identify bugs and shortcomings so that we can make Shelter of Exiles a great game.

[*] Account saves in the playtests will reset in later versions of the game, so please don't get too attached to your characters. However, feel free to go wild!
[/list]
Armed with this knowledge, head into the game now. We recommend familiarizing yourself with the tutorial missions to learn the ropes and then progressing through the next levels to test the combat system, its capabilities, and player progression.

[b]Don't forget to share your valuable feedback using the form link below and send us save files. Recordings are also very welcome![/b]

Form link: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeV9puZxjLKGV5OjPtFuLZBQZM6R5-ZvnIXnvH07u0Sif3HOA/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeV9puZxjLKGV5OjPtFuLZBQZM6R5-ZvnIXnvH07u0Sif3HOA/viewform[/url]

notes.title: Devlog - Combat
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back, Exiles![/b]

Are you ready to dive into the dynamic combat of "Shelter of Exiles" and master the hexagonal battlegrounds that await? Ever wondered how strategic positioning can turn the tides of battle in real-time?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/9bcfc64507e2517fce217e37ef654d2086e873f8.png[/img]

[b]What is the Combat System in Shelter of Exiles? [/b]

The combat in "Shelter of Exiles" is an exhilarating blend of real-time action and strategic gameplay. Set on a hexagonal grid, each match cycle (level) unfolds on a vibrant battlefield populated with heroes, monsters, collectible power-ups, terrain effects, and obstacles. This isn't just a fight; it's a dance of war where every step counts.

[b]How Does It Work? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/39a37158194168af08dae32d37c303aa8d52e7f0.png[/img]

As a player, you'll navigate this chess-like arena with clicks, commanding your character to move, attack, and cast spells on the fly. The hexagonal spaces not only define movement but also serve as strategic points to gain the upper hand. By clicking on the tiles or selecting abilities, your character springs into action, responding to your every command with precision.

[b]How Will It Affect Gameplay?[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/ddbd71de7d2577514592086f03d09ae92b190a0c.png[/img]

The hex-based combat system elevates the gameplay by demanding a balance of quick reflexes and foresight. Whether you're flanking an enemy, dodging a fatal blow, or setting up a spell combo with environmental bonuses, your strategic prowess will be as crucial as your reaction speed. Closed arena battles with mission-specific objectives mean every fight is a unique puzzle to solve.

[b]What New Opportunities Does This Create? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/c465aff9b2c9f3a883303aafe763bb9d5e8eeba0.png[/img]

This combat system opens up avenues for new tactics. Do you lure enemies into traps, or go head-on with spells blazing? Maybe you prefer to collect power-ups, bolstering your abilities for a devastating counter-attack. The game's design allows for varied play styles, from the hands-on brawler to the tactical spell-caster.

[b]Tips and Tricks[/b]

[list]
[*] Study the arena before rushing into battle; understanding the layout is half the victory.
[*] Keep an eye on terrain effects—they can be both a blessing and a curse.
[*] Use auto-move and auto-attack features to manage the chaos and focus on high-impact decisions.
[*] Synergy is key: Combine your abilities with environmental features to unleash their full potential.
[/list]

[b]Planned Improvements [/b]

We're constantly refining the combat experience, with plans to introduce more varied terrain effects, new power-ups, and even greater enemy variety to keep you on your toes.

[b]We Welcome Your Feedback! [/b]

Your strategies, your victories, your challenges—share them all! We're building this world together, Exiles, and your voice helps us fine-tune the clashing of swords and the whisper of spells. What would you like to see in the future of "Shelter of Exiles" combat? Let us know on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Vv3y88zTyX]Discord[/url].

[url=https://discord.com/invite/Vv3y88zTyX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750555/85229817a09ca9bff22343dc98e6e6b5e0bad509.png[/img][/url]

Stay sharp, strategize, and may your exile be thrilling!

[i]Yours "Pixel Trapps" team[/i]
